content: Yesu yaluyaluwa biꞌi ꞌiula apwesedi
ꞌEnega siabala ga silugu me Gelasine ꞌidi leꞌawaya,
ga wagega Yesu ꞌisuya dabalaya, ta tai ꞌebweu ꞌilobena mayaluyaluwa biꞌina ꞌina ꞌebemiya duluwa, ꞌenega ꞌiapwesama, ta duluwa nina tomota ꞌadi ꞌaliꞌali.
Ta tai gete lowa tomota sitoo be ꞌaene sida yoni malakwa kainumu ꞌenega, ta nigeya sawesawediya,
manuna malakwa nidi nimanaya be ꞌaenaya tuta yauna ꞌilasalasadi ta nigeya ꞌebweu sawesawenaya be ꞌigiyai,
ta ꞌidena sinedi ga ꞌitauya mitawaya ta boiboiya be ꞌasiyataya ꞌaliꞌaliya be ꞌoyaya ꞌiemagamagana, ta tauna gulewega ꞌiunuunu.
Ta tai nina niꞌatu ꞌedasolega Yesu ꞌiꞌitenama, ꞌenega ꞌipili ga Yesu matanaya ꞌilobwagoena,
ta ꞌimagana toila, ꞌigwae, “Yesu ye, ꞌoyo Yaubada Toewaiwai sana Natuna, toꞌase ꞌutootoo be ꞌuguinuwe ꞌeguya? Tuwa! Yaubada ꞌana esanega yasida ꞌemuya be geyaꞌabo ꞌuda giegieꞌelouyagu.”
Ona gete ꞌiꞌinanena manuna Yesu niꞌatu ꞌieonena, “Yaluyaluwa biꞌi niyo tai gete ꞌenega ꞌuapwesama.”
Ta Yesu wate ꞌienaida yaluyaluwa nina ꞌena, ꞌigwae, “Mwaꞌadega ꞌamu esana?” Ga tauna ꞌigwae, “ꞌAgu esana Tomoyauyau, manuna mabodama tai gete solanaya ꞌamiyami.”
Ga ꞌisidasida gewagewana Yesu ꞌena ꞌaene geyaꞌabo ꞌasa gote ꞌenega ꞌietuetune apwesedi.
Ta sena gote ꞌenaya bawe yauna siduwaduwala ꞌoyaya.
Ta yaluyaluwa biꞌi nidi sisida Yesu ꞌenaya ga sigwae, “Uetunema be ꞌalulugu bawe gotedi ꞌediya.”

ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌitagwaledi ga yaluyaluwa biꞌi tai nina ꞌenega siapwesa ga bawe ꞌediya silugu, ꞌenega bawe nidi siekabaleya ga maiboꞌadi sipili bulibuliyasu ga babagega sisobu olaya ga sidamana. Ta bawe nidi ꞌadi yau nadigega tu tausani.

ꞌEnega bawe ꞌadi toꞌitaꞌiꞌitao ꞌidi matautega sidena ga sitauya ꞌasaya, ga yage nidi siꞌitedi maiboꞌana sisimanedi ꞌasa sinabwana be ꞌasa gidalidi tomotenidi ꞌediya. ꞌEnega toniꞌasa nidi simai be ꞌaene taudi matadiyega sida ꞌita toꞌase ꞌiapwesa.
Ta Yesu ꞌena simai ga tai nina bada siꞌitena, lowa yaluyaluwa biꞌi solanaya simiyami niꞌatu debana ꞌipalupalu ga ꞌoama ꞌiꞌotena ta ꞌimiyami. Gote ꞌena maiboꞌadi simatauta.
ꞌEnega toepilialeale nidi tomotai ꞌediya siemwasala mwaꞌadega tai nina ꞌiboboꞌanaꞌesa, ta mwaꞌadega bawe siesilaeꞌesa.
Ta toniꞌasa nidi silolagata ga Yesu sieꞌidiꞌidiyena ꞌaene ꞌidi sena ꞌida pilisine.
ꞌEnega Yesu wagaya ꞌidolodolo sabi gelu, ta tai nina niꞌa ꞌigieboboꞌanena Yesu ꞌena ꞌisida, ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana, sawesawenaya yamuliyeyo?”
Ta Yesu ꞌigwae, “Nigeya sawesawenaya, ta esi ꞌuila be ꞌutatauya ꞌimu susuyao ꞌediya be Yaubada ꞌina ꞌatenuwaꞌoleꞌoleyega ꞌigieboboꞌanemuya ꞌuemwasali be sida nono.”
ꞌEnega tai nina ꞌitauya ꞌebeloina Dekapoli ꞌana ꞌasa sanau ꞌediya ga Yesu ꞌina guinuwa waiwaina manuna ꞌietetela ga tomota maiboꞌadi sinonona ga nuwadi ꞌiowana.
Yesu iine ꞌeluwa ꞌigieboboꞌanedi
Ga Yesu ma ꞌana tomuliyao siabala limana, ga boda sinabwana siegogonama leꞌawa nina ꞌenaya.
ꞌEnega ꞌebweu tai, ꞌana esana Yailo, tauna anuwa tapwalolo ꞌana toꞌitaꞌiꞌita, ꞌimai ga Yesu ꞌilobena ga matanaya ꞌibwagobwago,
ga ꞌisida waiwai, ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana, natugu mewainena ꞌana leꞌoasa ꞌimwau ꞌaiꞌaila, ta tauna gwama tuga, ta nuwanuwagu ꞌumama be ꞌuda gitoo be ꞌida boboꞌana, ta geyaꞌabo ꞌimwawamwawasa.”
ꞌEnega Yesu maꞌiyana sitautauya, ga boda sinabwana simulimuliye ta siegigigila ꞌedaya.
Ta boda nidi soladiya ꞌebweu waine maꞌedi ma ina leꞌoasa. Leꞌoasa nina nate lalana ꞌidaudau yakwala tuwelo ꞌediya, ta tuga ꞌetamo ꞌidaudau.
Lowa togileꞌoasa yaudi ꞌediya ꞌina mani maiboꞌana ꞌiloegumwalina, ta saꞌi ꞌidi guinuwa ꞌenega nigeya ꞌida boboꞌana, ta esi ꞌana leꞌoasa ꞌisinasinabwa.
Waine nina Yesu ꞌimuliyena manuna lowa tetelina ꞌinonona, ga ꞌatenaya ꞌinuwanuwa ꞌaene, “ꞌEguma tuga Yesu ꞌana ꞌoama namo yagitoo yada boboꞌana.” ꞌEnega ꞌiloselabena ga ꞌana ꞌoama ꞌigitoona
ga lalana ꞌina dau ꞌiyapasa manini, ta taunamo oona solanaya ꞌilotoona ꞌaene niꞌatu ꞌiboboꞌana.
Ta Yesu niꞌatu ꞌilotoona ꞌaene waiwai ꞌenega ꞌiapwesa ga ꞌiasakowasi ga boda ꞌienaidedi, ꞌigwae, “Yaita ꞌagu ꞌoama ꞌigitoona?”
Ta ꞌenega ꞌina tononoyao sieonena, “ꞌInapwana, niꞌatu ꞌuꞌitena boda siaꞌoabuꞌoabuyemu ta siegigigila, ga ꞌoyo ꞌuenaida, ‘Yaita ꞌigitoogu?’ ”
Ta Yesu ꞌiloꞌita dadana tomota gamwagamwanidiya be ꞌida ꞌita yaita ꞌina waiwai ꞌena ꞌiabala.
Ta waine nina taunamo ꞌana boboꞌana niꞌa ꞌilobena ꞌimwalatonina, ꞌenega ꞌimai ga ma ina dedela ꞌina matauta manuna ꞌibeꞌu sanamwaꞌuta matanaya ga ꞌisimana ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌaene tauna ꞌiguinuwena.
Ta Yesu ꞌigwae, “Natugu, ꞌimu emisa ꞌenega ꞌuboboꞌana. ꞌUtoolo be ma imu gwausowala ꞌutatauya. ꞌImu leꞌoasa maiboꞌana niꞌatu ꞌigumwala.”
Tuta nina Yesu ꞌionaona waine ꞌenaya ꞌaina tomota Yailo ꞌina anuwega ale simeꞌena, ga sigwae, “Natuyo niꞌatu yawasina ꞌigumwala, ta geyaꞌabo wate toeꞌita nina ꞌina tuta ꞌumudamudali.”
Ta Yesu wate ale nina ꞌinonona ga Yailo ꞌieonena, ꞌigwae, “Geyaꞌabo ꞌuꞌateꞌate saꞌala, ta esi ꞌuemisegu tuga.”
ꞌEnega Yesu boda yauna ꞌiꞌetobodedi be geyaꞌabo simulimuliye, ta nate namo ꞌina tononoyao sitetoi maꞌenao, nate Pita be Yemesa matasina tauna Yoni
sitautauya ga Yailo ꞌina anuwaya siapwesa ga ꞌewabamu be dedoi sinabwana sinonona.
Ta Yesu ꞌilugu ga ꞌieonedi, “Toꞌase manuna wadedoi ta waegalagalala? Gwama nigeya ꞌimwawamwawasa ta ꞌiꞌeno mwataya tuga.”
Ta siedagiyena. Ta esi Yesu ꞌipaꞌidi ga siapwesa, ta gwama tamana be sinana be ꞌina tononoyao sitetoi Yesu maꞌedi silugu gwama ꞌina ꞌebeꞌeno ꞌenaya.
Ta Yesu gwama nimanaya ꞌigiyaina ga ꞌigwae, “Talita kumi.” Ta ꞌana gibui, “Negeyo ꞌutoolo.”
ꞌEnega ꞌitoolo manini ga ꞌiadadana, manuna ꞌana yakwala niꞌatu tuwelo ꞌilobena. Ta tamana be sinana nuwadi ꞌiowana ꞌaiꞌaila.
Ga Yesu ꞌiꞌetobodedi ꞌigwae, “Geyaꞌabo ꞌebweu yaita ꞌena wasimasimana ꞌigu guinuwa gete manuna, ta esi gwama ꞌana masula wagibubu be ꞌiꞌaꞌa.”
